hooks.name: Refuse To Style Over Conflict Markers
hooks.description: Hard stop (exit 2) if the target file still contains unresolved merge conflict markers.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path -LiteralPath '${file}') { if (Select-String -LiteralPath '${file}' -Pattern '^<<<<<<< ' -Quiet -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('BLOCKED: resolve merge conflict markers in this file first'); exit 2 } }; exit 0"
